name: adsb.lol API
summary: Free live ADS-B aircraft positions from a community feeder network, ADS-B Exchange v2 compatible, open data under ODbL.
description: Real-time aircraft state (position, altitude, speed, squawk, type, registration) queried by point and radius, hex code, callsign, registration, squawk or military flag. It is a drop-in replacement for the ADS-B Exchange v2 API. Plausible-route lookups are also offered.

auth.notes: No key needed today. The README says a key obtainable by feeding adsb.lol may be required in the future.

rate_limit.summary: Dynamic, based on load. Responses carried x-ratelimit-limit: 500, 500;w=86400 and a remaining counter.

endpoints.summary: Aircraft within a radius in nautical miles

agent_notes: Same field names as the ADS-B Exchange v2 API (alt_baro can be the string ground). Radius is in nautical miles. Poll gently and cache; the limit is dynamic.
caveats: No CORS header was sent, so browser use needs a proxy.
api.adsb.lol/docs and /openapi.json returned 503 during my checks, so the endpoint list comes from the README and the working calls.
The point query took about 4 s on its first call and 0.3 s on a repeat.

verification.notes: Exact example request executed without a key.
